title: Plan Crosswalk: know who to call first this AEP
body_markdown:
Every AEP starts with the same question. What's happening to this member's plan, and who needs a call first?


Plan Crosswalk answers it for your whole book at once.


## What Plan Crosswalk shows you


It runs every policy in your book against 2027 plan data, covering every county in the US. Out comes a list of every member affected, sorted by what changed:


- Plan ending or leaving their county
- Premium going up
- Out-of-pocket max going up
- Benefits lost: dental, vision, OTC, fitness, meals, transportation
- Star rating dropping


When a plan is gone, it finds the closest match in the member's county and spells out the differences on premium, MOOP, and benefits.


Every member gets a tag:


- **Red:** plan ending or leaving the county. They need a new plan.
- **Yellow:** costs or benefits changing. They need a walkthrough.
- **Green:** nothing material changing. They get a check-in.


## Turn the list into booked appointments


Your members should hear about their 2027 plan from the agency that already takes care of them.


Drop the list into the AEP Renewals 2027 campaign and AI employees call every member about their own plan. Each call is written for that member's plan and county. Anyone who wants an agent gets transferred live or booked on the spot. Texts back up every call, so members have the changes in writing.


Your agents walk into a full calendar, and every conversation starts with the plan change already on the table.


Plan recommendations stay with your licensed agents. Opt-outs are honored immediately. All outreach wraps December 8.


## Already have a crosswalk?


Bring it. Import your members with your own plan-change notes and red, yellow, or green tags, and AI employees run the same AEP campaign on your data. Same calls, same transfers, same booked appointments.[Bring your own crosswalk](https://docs.carecycle.ai/docs/guides/aep-2027/bring-your-own-crosswalk)


Running outreach in your own tools? Every crosswalk also exports to CSV.
